hypothesis: Given the same sanitized failure excerpt and the same output contract, a zero-tool model that receives the debugger skill text (SKILL.md plus report-acquisition.md, artifact-extraction.md, classification-procedure.md, fix-verification.md; the model-visible surface of debugger-holdout-v1) classifies the F1-F15 root cause more accurately than the same model given only the F-code legend (ID and title) parsed from the same SKILL.md.

arms.skill: prompt frame + full debugger skill text for the case's framework + excerpt
arms.no-skill: prompt frame + 15-line F-code legend (ID: title) + excerpt; legend-only, not taxonomy-free

hosts.role: secondary, run only if quota allows; same rule applies per host

schedule: one seeded shuffle of all case x arm x repetition cells; arms interleave
labels: author-written; two blind model labelers (claude sonnet, claude opus; fresh contexts; saw only the two debugger SKILL.md F tables, both classification-procedure.md files, and the unlabeled packet) matched 30/30 f_code and 30/30 diagnosis. No human labeled the corpus.
primary_metric: F-code accuracy per call -> mean per case per arm -> paired per-case difference (skill minus no-skill) -> mean lift
secondary_metrics: input/output tokens and summed wall time per arm

decision_rule.ci: paired case-cluster bootstrap of per-case differences, stratified by framework
decision_rule.PASS: lift >= min_lift AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND skill diagnosis accuracy >= no-skill diagnosis accuracy - max_diagnosis_drop
decision_rule.FAIL: all scheduled calls scored, no input drift, and PASS conditions not met
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: any scheduled call without a scoreable prediction after the retry policy, or any input digest drift

power_note: No pilot variance was available. Assuming a paired per-case SD of 0.35 over 30 cases, the minimum detectable effect is about 0.18 at alpha 0.05 and power 0.8; a true +0.10 lift can be missed.
limits: Public, model-authored corpus and labels; the author is the same model family as the primary host.
Zero-tool prompt measures interpretation of the skill text, not the end-to-end debugger workflow (artifact reader, isolation probes, fix verification).
Short synthetic excerpts with one planted lookalike each, not full reports or traces.
The no-skill arm receives the F-code legend so exact scoring is possible; it is not an unprompted baseline.
Runner and model strings are provenance, not attestation.
